zh: 我还在另一座岛，先带我一起过去吧。
en: I’m on another island. Bring me along first.

zh: 你交代的事还没做完，等我忙完再来。
en: I’m still on the job you gave me. Invite me when I’m done.

zh: 我现在想安静一会儿，过一会儿再叫我吧。
en: I need a quiet moment. Ask me again in a little while.

zh: 我现在太饿了，暂时没法答应邀请。
en: I’m too hungry to accept right now.

zh: 我手上的东西还没安置好，等我一下。
en: My hands are full. Give me a moment.
